environment.description: ECS Fargate task running in a private subnet with NAT gateway. Task role has s3:PutObject, s3:DeleteObject, s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::* and sqs:* on the queue. No VPC endpoint policies. No DNS filtering. The task can resolve arbitrary DNS and connect to any IP including 169.254.169.254 metadata service and internal VPC addresses. No permission boundary attached to the task role.

config.network: Private subnet with NAT, no DNS filtering, no VPC endpoint policies
config.iam_policy: s3:PutObject,s3:DeleteObject,s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::*, sqs:* on queue ARN
